description: Quality issues from field, plant, supplier and test origins.
data_classification: SIMULATED ENTERPRISE ARTEFACT - not OEM, customer or proprietary data

records.title: Thermal derate during sustained high ambient highway operation
records.description: Multiple DV vehicles report a reduction in available drive power after approximately 40 to 55 minutes of sustained highway operation at ambient temperatures above 35 degC. Derate is accompanied by battery maximum cell temperature approaching the protection threshold.
records.detected_at: DV test fleet, hot climate route

records.title: DC fast charge time exceeds target at low ambient
records.description: DC charge time from 10 to 80 percent measured at 8 degC ambient exceeds the target by 9 to 14 minutes across three vehicles.

records.title: Charge session termination at high state of charge on specific stations
records.description: Charging sessions terminate unexpectedly above 70 percent state of charge on a subset of DC charging stations. Vehicle side logs show a current step change immediately preceding termination.

records.title: Intermittent radiated emissions failure in the 76 to 108 MHz band
records.description: Full vehicle EMC measurement shows an intermittent exceedance in the FM broadcast band during DC charging. The exceedance is not reproducible on every run.

records.title: Front suspension knock noise on rough road surfaces
records.description: Knock or clonk noise reported from the front suspension over sharp road inputs. Reported on vehicles built after week 22.

records.title: Cooling plate coolant leak found at pack assembly
records.description: Two cooling plates rejected at pack final assembly leak test. Both traced to the same supplier production week.
records.detected_at: Pack assembly line, leak test station

records.title: Brake judder reported after 8000 km
records.description: Steering wheel vibration under moderate braking from 100 km/h reported on early DV vehicles with the revised friction compound.

records.title: Low speed brake squeal
records.description: Audible squeal during low speed braking, more frequent in humid conditions and after overnight parking.

records.title: Cell voltage spread growth after extended parking
records.description: Cell voltage spread exceeds the expected value after vehicles are parked for more than 14 days.

records.title: Continuous power shortfall on extended gradient
records.description: Vehicles show power reduction during sustained gradient climbing before the expected thermal limit is reached.

records.title: Bushing radial stiffness out of specification at incoming inspection
records.description: Incoming inspection identified a batch of front lower control arm bushings with radial stiffness below the lower specification limit.

records.title: Busbar weld resistance high on module line
records.description: In-process weld monitoring flagged elevated resistance on a sequence of modules.

records.title: HV contactor fails to open after DC fast charge
records.description: One vehicle reported a fault indicating the DC charge contactor did not confirm the open state after a fast charge session.

records.title: Compressor tonal noise audible in cabin at idle
records.description: Tonal noise from the HVAC compressor audible in the cabin when the vehicle is stationary with high cooling demand.

records.title: Range estimate optimistic in cold conditions
records.description: Displayed range over-estimates achievable range by 12 to 18 percent at ambient temperatures below 5 degC.

records.title: Rear subframe boom noise at 45 to 60 km/h on coarse surfaces
records.description: Low frequency boom noise reported on coarse asphalt in the 45 to 60 km/h range.

records.title: Pack pressure equalisation vent blocked
records.description: One pack rejected at end of line for failing the vent flow verification.

records.title: Catalyst light-off time increased on aged parts
records.description: Aged catalyst samples with the reduced loading show longer light-off time than the previous formulation.

records.title: Steering assist response slower than target on the successor microcontroller
records.description: Bench measurement on the prototype ECU with the successor microcontroller shows assist response outside the specified time constant.

records.title: Tyre rolling resistance above allocation on the 20 inch specification
records.description: Bench measurement of the 255/45R20 tyre shows rolling resistance above the vehicle energy budget allocation.

records.title: 12V supply dip during simultaneous high load events
records.description: Bench measurement shows LV supply voltage dipping below the specified band during simultaneous steering, braking and thermal system demand after the battery relocation proposal.

records.title: Cell voltage sense intermittent on vibration test
records.description: Cell voltage sense signal dropout observed during pack vibration testing.

records.title: Bus load exceeded limit on the integration bench
records.description: Communication bus utilisation exceeded the defined limit after the addition of new charge control signals.

records.title: Seal compression set after thermal cycling
records.description: Pack perimeter seal shows compression set beyond the qualification limit after accelerated thermal cycling.

records.title: Supplier PPAP submission incomplete for transferred bushing
records.description: PPAP submission for the transferred bushing production location is missing process capability evidence for the cure process.

records.title: Ride comfort target exceeded with the 20 inch wheel specification
records.description: Vertical ride acceleration on reference surfaces exceeds the comfort target with the 20 inch wheel and tyre combination.
